hints.title: Audit each transition in order
hints.body: Read each equality using only the original domain and the earlier valid lines. Check the operation used at every transition before deciding where the argument first fails.
hints.recap: A proof needs every deduction to follow from its stated assumptions.
hints.pitfall: An absurd conclusion tells you that something failed, but does not locate the first invalid step.
hints.pause: List the operations in order and check the conditions each requires.

recall.reminder: Inspect each step using only the original assumptions and previous valid lines.

hints.title: Test a sign-sensitive step
hints.body: A principal square root is nonnegative. Choose an allowed angle for which a trigonometric value is negative, then compare both sides of the displayed equalities in order.
hints.recap: One allowed input can refute an identity claimed for every input.
hints.pitfall: Squaring two quantities can conceal a difference in their signs.
hints.pause: Choose and evaluate your test angle, identify the first failed equality and explain which sign condition is missing.

recall.reminder: A counterexample must satisfy the original domain and falsify the claimed equality.

solution:
A is true for every real x. Rearranging it yields cos2x=1−sin2x, but taking the principal square root gives |cosx|=1−sin2x.

Line B replaces |cosx| with cosx without a nonnegative-cosine restriction. At x=π, B asserts −1=1.

The first error is B. Later algebra merely carries this false equality forward.
knowledgePattern: Locate loss of sign on taking a square root
